title: Why gold hates real yields
hook: A war just started — so why did gold go DOWN?
metaphor: Gold and bonds are two lifeguards applying for the same job: protecting your money from rising prices. The one that pays more gets hired.
body: Bonds pay interest. Gold pays nothing at all.
So the real question is: after inflation, do bonds still pay something?
When bonds pay well after inflation, big money picks bonds. Gold falls or sleeps.
When bonds stop paying after inflation, gold gets the job. That is when it runs.

caveat: This is a strong pattern, not a law. Gold has ignored it for stretches — like when central banks were buying tons of it.
